name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
description: Provides cashless health insurance for eligible families.
benefit: Health insurance up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year.

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
description: Promotes institutional delivery for pregnant women.
benefit: Financial assistance for safe institutional delivery.

name: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK)
description: Free delivery and newborn care services.
benefit: Free medicines, diagnostics, food and transport.

name: Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram (RBSK)
benefit: Free health screening and early intervention.

name: National Programme for Health Care of the Elderly (NPHCE)
benefit: Free geriatric care and regular health check-ups.
